title: Please add "Vibrate on alert" option for "Extra Alerts (xDrip+)"
body:
Currently, unless I am mistaken, if you enable any of the "Extra Alerts (xDrip+)", those being Persistent High Alert and Forecast Lows, they also vibrate with no choice of disabling the vibration.  You either have to not use the alert, or you have to put up with the vibration.

However, you have the choice of enabling or disabling the vibration for the main xDrip alerts, those being Low Alert, Too Low Alert, and High Alert.

Would you please add the option to disable the vibration for the Extra Alerts (xDrip+)?

comments.body:
It doesn't vibrate.
I don't remember why I opened this ticket.  I don't know how I stopped it if it did.  But, those alerts don't vibrate!
